svg.title: Panel anatomy: 2 × 2 V-scored panel with rails
svg.desc: Drawn to scale. Four 70 × 45 mm boards in two rows of two, with a 10 mm rail along the top and bottom long edges, making a 140 × 110 mm panel. The rails carry three global fiducials, one on the top rail and two on the bottom rail, and four optional 3/16 in tooling holes. Dashed V-score lines run edge to edge between the boards and between the boards and the rails. Each board has two fiducials near opposite corners. The panel travels left to right, parallel to the rails.

g.text: About 10 mm; carried by conveyors and clamps
On the rail; used while the panel is whole
3/16 in at one assembler; now often unused
1 mm dot, 2 mm mask opening, 2 per board
Runs edge to edge in a straight line
Your design: one of four in the panel
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
